name: route-core
description: Minimal, zero-runtime-dependency routing engine for Node.js frameworks.

scripts.build:dev: node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.dev.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
scripts.build:publish: node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:built
scripts.test:shared: npm run build && npm run test:shared:built
scripts.test:router: npm run build && npm run test:router:built
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package:built
scripts.bench: npm run build && npm run bench:built
scripts.bench:gate: npm run build && npm run bench:gate:built
scripts.bench:hot: npm run build && npm run bench:hot:built
scripts.bench:compat: npm run build && npm run bench:compat:built
